chapter: San Francisco, the So Different Orchestra and Johnny
title: The 1915 So Different Orchestra photograph and its members
summary: Willard and Spikes go through the tinted photo of the So Different Orchestra, naming Clarence Williams, Slocum Mitchell, Gerald Wells, Sid LaProtty and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was his first name? I know the sons.

Woody Woodman. Wait a minute. I got a picture of the band up there. Oh, you got a picture of the big band, yeah. Gimme this. I'll put it away. You cut this off a minute?
[Resumes] Pacific Street, you know, and this is the band that and we went downtown to a place called...called the...uh...that big white nightclub downtown. It had the biggest...I think it had two hundred girls in the show.
In San Francisco?

Yeah. We played down there, and they had ice skating rink, and they had two shows a night, and we played for the show and all of the different acts and things. Then when we left there, we came to Los Angeles, and I told you we went to work in Watts for Baron Long where we'd play for Rudolph Valentino.
Can we go back to this? This is the...
The band that played for Rudolph Valentino.
Okay, let's describe what we've got here. You went and got this giant picture that's about four feet wide and...
May five...
And about three feet deep, and it's in color --or it's been tinted colored --and it's from 1915, and it says, "So Different Orchestra," and from left to right, the bass player is who?
